name: com.rubickanov.audio
description: Audio service with SFX pooling, loops in 2D, at a point or attached to a transform, music playback, sounds that play on a paused listener, AudioMixer-based volume control, 3D sound kinds (distance, air, width, reverb send, head shadow, occlusion), a lookahead true-peak output limiter, a mixer layout kit and an output capture.
